proof_summary.structural_loss_guard: internal/forgetting.hasStructuralLoss now covers unique meaning, provenance, scope, historical value, and rationale; consolidation escalates to review_required and destroy remains blocked.
proof_summary.packet_preview_vs_mutation: ForgettingReviewPacket carries preview.before_refs, preview.after_plan, approval_required, mutation_separated, read_only=true, and mutation_requirements; PreviewReviewAction returns a no-write preview while ValidateForgettingMutationBoundary enforces mutation gates separately.
proof_summary.snapshot_and_audit_substrate: Risky forgetting packets use bulk_op_snapshots + audit_log and the new forgetting_review_action SnapshotOpType. Migration 154 and MCP list_snapshots enum expose the op type for readback.
proof_summary.audit_before_mutate: Mutation requirements explicitly require AuditWriteBeforeMutation=true and SnapshotRequired=true; NewForgettingReviewActionSnapshot binds approved packets to migration-154 op_type before any later mutation path can apply.
proof_summary.destructive_guard: Destroy packets are blocked by default and ValidateForgettingMutationBoundary rejects blocked packets. Archive is listed before destroy.
